title: Standing Delivery Specification for Office Pantry & Beverage Program Sites
content:
Every Office Pantry & Beverage Program tier is specified for a standing replenishment pattern and for the unscheduled work that sits outside it. The figures below are the specification printed against each tier.

## Standing replenishment pattern

| Tier | Standing deliveries each week | Length of each delivery window (hours) | Notice to change the standing list (calendar days) | Contents fixed this many hours before a delivery | Share of a delivery that may be substituted when a product is short (percent) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Coffee & Tea Service | 1 | 1.0 | 5 | 48 | 25.00 |
| Standard Snack Pantry | 2 | 1.5 | 5 | 48 | 20.00 |
| Fresh Pantry Program | 3 | 2.0 | 7 | 72 | 15.00 |
| Barista Bar Program | 3 | 2.5 | 7 | 72 | 12.00 |
| Full Hospitality Pantry Program | 5 | 3.0 | 10 | 96 | 10.00 |
| Campus Pantry Network Program | 5 | 5.0 | 14 | 120 | 14.00 |

## Unscheduled replenishment and emergency restock

| Tier | Charge for an unscheduled replenishment asked for by the client (USD) | Shortest notice at which an unscheduled replenishment is accepted (whole hours) | Charge for an emergency restock outside the delivery schedule (USD) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Coffee & Tea Service | 45.00 | 24 | 65.00 |
| Standard Snack Pantry | 65.00 | 24 | 85.00 |
| Fresh Pantry Program | 95.00 | 16 | 120.00 |
| Barista Bar Program | 125.00 | 12 | 160.00 |
| Full Hospitality Pantry Program | 165.00 | 8 | 210.00 |
| Campus Pantry Network Program | 210.00 | 8 | 245.00 |

## Notes to the specification

- The weekly visit count and the window length describe the standing pattern: the window is the length of each standing delivery window, stated to one decimal place in hours.
- The notice to change the standing list is a number of calendar days. The contents deadline is a number of hours before the delivery concerned.
- The substitution share is a percentage of one delivery.
- The unscheduled replenishment figures are the charge and the shortest notice, in whole hours, at which such a replenishment is accepted. The emergency restock charge is a separate figure for work outside the delivery schedule.

The substitution share does not fall steadily with the tier: Full Hospitality Pantry Program is specified at 10.00 percent while Campus Pantry Network Program, the tier above it, is specified at 14.00 percent. The shortest notice for an unscheduled replenishment is the same 8 hours on both of those tiers.
